vendor_option_semantics.-uResetCon=: -uResetCon= Specify whether hold reset during the connection progress. Default Value 0 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 No 1 Yes Example -uResetCon= 1
vendor_option_semantics.-uResetBeginConnection=: -uResetBeginConnection= Specifies the CPU should be reset at the beginning of connection. Default Value 1 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 No 1 Yes Example -uResetBeginConnection= 1
vendor_option_semantics.-uNoReset=: -uNoReset= Specify the CPU should not be reset at the end of connection. Default Value 1 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 Reset 1 Not Reset Example -uNoReset= 1
vendor_option_semantics.-uHotPlug=: -uHotPlug= Specify if connecting to an already running target system. Please refer Hot Plug page for more detailed information about Hot Plug feature. Default Value 0 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 Disabled 1 Enabled Example -uHotPlug= 0
vendor_option_semantics.-uAuthLevel=: -uAuthLevel= Specify the Authentication level. Default Value 0 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values Valid authentication level: 0 AL0: Ignores the key and connect without authentication 1 AL1: Authenticate device with key to AL1 3 AL2: Authenticate device with key to AL2 255 ALERASE: Intialize device back to AL2 Example -uAuthLevel= 3 Note Just using this parameter with the TrustZone device that supported for Authentication Level
vendor_option_semantics.-uEnableSciBoot=: -uEnableSciBoot= Specify whether the boundaries of memory regions need to be set to separate each memory region when a debugging connection is initiated. When this parameter is sent with value "1", it's neccessary to use the below command "-uMemRegion=" to set the memory region boundaries. Default Value 0 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 Disabled 1 Enabled Example -uEnableSciBoot= 1
vendor_option_semantics.-uDisconnectionMode=: -uDisconnectionMode= Specify the disconnection mode to control the target state after disconnecting. Default Value 2 Emulator E2, E2 Lite, J-Link Available Values 0 No change mode: leave the target in its current state 1 Stop mode: leave the target in halted state 2 Continue mode: For the J-Link: program starts the image from target's current PC value or leave it running. For the E2/E2 Lite: program will be start from reset. Example -uDisconnectionMode= 1 SWV
